title: Private Pedal Pub Tour in Austin
includes: Sound System you can connect your phone to
A driver to facilitate your tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Canned drinks only for BYOB. No hard liquor or glass containers.
We can usually accommodate same-day bookings, please just give us a call!
We do have a back bench that does not require pedaling for those unable to pedal.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We are a great BYOB tour for birthdays, bachelor/bachelorette parties, corporate events, weddings and reunions. Pedal-powered by you and 6 to 14 of your friends with the help of an electric pedal assist motor, its 5 mph top speed is just the right speed for sharing good times with friends as you tour scenic routes! Your awesome driver will bring the energy while keeping you safe. Our bikes are equipped with a sound system for blasting the soundtrack of your celebration! All tours are BYOB - we provide a cooler with ice. During your 2-hour tour you will enjoy the drinks you brought onto the bike while singing out loud to your favorite tunes! We'll make stops at a few bars along the way where you can purchase drinks to enjoy while there. We can also make stops at murals for pictures and food trucks if you like. Please note that our drivers are not trained to provide historical information. This is a fun pub crawl tour in scenic downtown.
